limit.title: COD cash limit
limit.loadFailed: Could not load your COD cash limit.
limit.overLimit: You hold more than your limit. Vendors cannot send you cash-on-delivery orders until you remit.
limit.remitFrees: Remitting cash to Wi-Mall frees room
limit.explain: This limit decides what vendors can dispatch to you: a cash-on-delivery order that would take you over it is held on the vendor's side, and you don't receive it until it fits or the vendor sends it anyway. It is not the per-order COD cap in your policies, and a change to it never pauses your connections.

deposits.alertBody: Confirm or reject within 2 days. Leaving a declaration unanswered opens a discrepancy that freezes your rolling-reserve releases.

deposits.rejectDescription: No money moves. The agent's late-deposit clock resumes and an admin can see both sides. Rejecting a claim you dispute is a normal, cost-free action.
deposits.rejectPlaceholder: e.g. Nothing was handed over at the desk; our till reconciles.
